_schema: v0.6k tavern+palace jobs. Replaces first-wave stubs in v06j_journal_quest_data.md. Journal fields (title, giver, destination, reward, risk, deadline, status) are present as display strings; structured fields drive logic. Thresholds are placeholders for balance.
declineRule: leave list until next visit, then rotate
highHonorSmugglingRule: High Honor never blocks contraband jobs; it applies highHonorModifiers (fewer offers, better pay, bigger hit if caught).

jobs.title: Rumour for Yusuf
jobs.summary: Carry a tip about Qarin buyers to Gwadar's tavern.
jobs.greeting: Word travels if you carry it. Interested?
jobs.journalText: Yusuf at Debal's tavern gave me a tip on House Qarin's buyers. Gwadar's tavern keeper will pay for it.
jobs.hint: Gwadar's tavern keeper will pay for the tip.

jobs.title: A Letter for Muscat
jobs.summary: A pearl diver's letter must reach his brother at Muscat's tavern before the monsoon turns.
jobs.greeting: The diver can't write twice. Will you take it?
jobs.journalText: Carry the pearl diver's letter to his brother at Muscat's tavern.
jobs.reward: 55 coins + Honor +1 + vague price rumour for Muscat
jobs.hint: Muscat's innkeeper knows every diver's family.

jobs.title: Indigo Without Papers
jobs.summary: Five bales of unstamped indigo, landed quietly on Muscat's night quay. Customs sleeps after the last prayer.
jobs.greeting: No stamps, no questions. Do you have a dark hold?
jobs.journalText: Run 5 bales of unstamped indigo from Debal to Muscat's night quay. Customs may seize it.
jobs.risk: Customs may seize cargo; caught: lose cargo, fine, Honor/Sultan hit
jobs.hint: Sail in after dark; the night quay is left of the lighthouse.

jobs.title: The Rope-Maker's Debt
jobs.summary: A Debal rope-maker owes the innkeeper 150 coins. Collect it, or forgive it in his name.
jobs.greeting: He swore on his father's beard. Bring me something.
jobs.journalText: Collect the rope-maker's debt in Debal, or forgive it. Return to Gwadar's tavern either way.
jobs.hint: The rope-maker works by Debal's market.

jobs.title: A Passenger Without a Name
jobs.summary: A veiled man needs passage to Gwadar and would rather the harbour master never saw his face.
jobs.greeting: He pays in silver and silence. You'll ask nothing.
jobs.journalText: Carry the nameless passenger to Gwadar without docking at the customs quay.
jobs.risk: Inspection may expose him; Sultan standing loss if caught
jobs.hint: Land him at Gwadar before you visit the harbour master.

jobs.title: A Navigator Lost Ashore
jobs.summary: An old navigator who reads the stars is drinking away his wages somewhere in Gwadar. Find him a berth.
jobs.greeting: He knows the Makran coast like his palm. Find him.
jobs.journalText: Find the drunken navigator in Gwadar's tavern and sign him to your dhow.

jobs.title: Escort to Gwadar
jobs.summary: Guard a tribute dhow home to Gwadar.
jobs.greeting: The Sultan's tribute must not wet a pirate's hands.
jobs.journalText: Escort the Sultan's tribute dhow from Muscat to Gwadar.
jobs.risk: Ambush chance raised on that leg
jobs.hint: Set sail for Gwadar with the tribute boat.

jobs.title: Sealed Papers for Debal
jobs.summary: The governor's sealed papers must reach Debal's governor. The wax must arrive unbroken.
jobs.greeting: Break the seal and you break my trust.
jobs.journalText: Carry the governor's sealed papers to Debal's palace before the deadline.
jobs.hint: Debal's governor holds court before noon.

jobs.title: The Raider of Ras Malan
jobs.summary: A raider with a red sail preys on the Gwadar run. Sink him, or bring proof of the wreck.
jobs.greeting: Bring me his sail and I'll fill your purse.
jobs.journalText: Hunt the red-sailed raider on the Debal-Gwadar route. Report back to Debal's governor.
jobs.risk: Forced ambush fight on the route
jobs.hint: He hunts the Gwadar run near Ras Malan.

jobs.title: Pearls for the Court
jobs.summary: Deliver 3 chests of Gwadar pearls to the Sultan's treasury, untouched and on time.
jobs.greeting: The court counts every pearl twice.
jobs.journalText: Buy or carry 3 chests of pearls from Gwadar to the Muscat palace treasury.

jobs.title: Inspect the Qarin Dhow
jobs.summary: A House Qarin dhow is moored at Gwadar. Search its hold and report what they hide.
jobs.greeting: Qarin smiles too much. Look beneath the dates.
jobs.journalText: Search the Qarin dhow in Gwadar harbour and report to the governor.
jobs.risk: If target is Farida's goods: Farida ally loyalty -
jobs.hint: The Qarin dhow flies a green pennant.

jobs.title: Speak for the Pearl Houses
jobs.summary: The Sultan's majlis meets tomorrow. Speak for Gwadar's pearl houses and bring a fitting gift.
jobs.greeting: A captain with a good name is heard at court.
jobs.journalText: Bring a gift worth at least 100 coins to the Muscat majlis and speak for Gwadar's pearl houses.
jobs.hint: Pearls or coffee make a fitting gift.
